subject: Voyant Labs — MSA & Order Form kickoff
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@voyantlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Voyant Labs - MSA & Order Form kickoff

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to move forward. Our procurement and legal teams asked that we kick off the contracting process for an MSA and the initial Order Form/SOW. Can you send over your standard MSA template and an editable order form?

High-level timing: we'd like a signed agreement within 3 weeks if possible. Key items our finance and procurement will focus on: billing cadence, payment terms, PO flow, and any minimum commitments on dedicated capacity.

Also: can you confirm where data will be stored (US/EU) and point me to SOC2 evidence? Our security lead (cc'd in a separate email) will follow up with a questionnaire.

Attaching: Voyant internal note (no PII).

Cheers,
Elena Park
Head of Partnerships | Voyant Labs
elena@voyantlabs.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@voyantlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Voyant Labs - MSA & Order Form kickoff

Elena — great to hear, thanks. I'll start the intake here and loop in Legal and Billing. Quick asks so we can assemble a clean package: 

- Full counterparty legal name and address to populate Exhibits and signature block.
- Who will be the signing authority (name/title)?
- Primary technical contact for onboarding and SSO (name/email).
- Procurement contact and PO process (email and any billing instructions).
- Data residency preference (US only / US+EU / other).

I'll attach our baseline MSA and a fillable Order Form for your team to review. Marissa — can you take a first pass on likely redlines given this is a SaaS inference platform? Kimberly — can you confirm billing flow options we support for committed Dedicated capacity?

Proposed timeline: initial redlines back from Voyant by EOD 4/09, then legal sync 4/10 if needed. If that doesn't work for procurement, call out the constraints.

Thanks — I'll upload the docs to our shared drive and paste links once done.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Voyant Labs - MSA & Order Form kickoff

Jonas / Elena — looping in Legal's initial snapshot. Attached are two files: 'Voyant_MSA_redline_20270406.docx' (track changes against our standard MSA) and 'OrderForm_comments_20270406.pdf' (callouts on billing and SLAs). Summary below — please review with your teams and flag any items that are non-starters.

Key redline highlights (short):
- Liability cap: we propose mutual cap tied to 12 months of fees; if Voyant needs a higher cap, we'll need commercial justification and exec approval.
- Data residency & retention: default is US, can add EU residency for customer data with annex; pricing impact to be discussed.
- Audit & security: limited audit rights with pre-approved scope and frequency; we can provide SOC2 report via secure link.
- Termination for convenience: 90 days with pro-rated wind-down for committed capacity; we need clarity on ramp/degrowth crediting.
- IP & outputs: standard customer-output carveouts; we will not assign model weights.
- Exhibit B (Billing): need exact billing contacts and PO workflow to avoid delays.

Process suggestion: Voyant provides counterparty details + procurement contact; internal redline exchange within 5 business days. If there are material commercial asks (cap, residency), escalate to Sales Leadership for a quick approval.

Attachments: Voyant_MSA_redline_20270406.docx (redline), OrderForm_comments_20270406.pdf (annotated).
